Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the second WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly extracted the birth date of H. Bruce Humberstone. The WebSurfer provided the correct date of "November 18, 1901", but the Planner mistakenly recorded it as "November 18, 2001". This transcription error led to the false conclusion that Humberstone was born in the 21st century, causing the final comparison to incorrectly favor Lucio Fulci (born 1927) as the earlier-born director, when in reality Humberstone (born 1901) was born earlier.
